name: migration-atlas
description: SQL migration files: summary, destructive operations, tables. Pro: PostgreSQL lock-risk review and a rollback plan. Works offline.

commands.title: Migration Atlas: Show PostgreSQL Lock Risks (Pro)
Migration Atlas: Remove Licence From This Machine

walkthroughs.title: Get started with Migration Atlas
walkthroughs.description: Open a sample migration, see its summary, destructive operations and tables, and try the Pro lock-risk review and rollback plan in the free 14-day trial.

steps.title: Open a sample file
steps.description:
Migration Atlas reads SQL migration files, the scripts that change a database schema. The sample is an invented release migration of a shop database with typical lock risks and one destructive change, so every report has something to show. Open it to follow along, or open a migration of your own.
[Open Sample File](command:migrationAtlas.openSample)

steps.title: Run Show Summary
steps.description:
The migration at a glance: how many statements of each kind, how many tables, and whether it runs in a transaction. The report opens as a new Markdown document; your file is not changed.
[Show Summary](command:migrationAtlas.showSummary)

steps.title: Use the other free reports
steps.description:
Every free report works without a key, an account or a network connection: Show Destructive Operations, Show Tables.
[Show Destructive Operations](command:migrationAtlas.showDestructive)
[Show Tables](command:migrationAtlas.showTables)

steps.title: Try Pro free for 14 days
steps.description:
The first Pro command you run starts a free 14-day trial on this computer, with no key and no network: Show PostgreSQL Lock Risks, Show Rollback Plan.
[Show PostgreSQL Lock Risks](command:migrationAtlas.showLockRisk)

steps.title: Licence and help
steps.description:
Buy Pro (Personal USD 19, Business USD 39 per user), enter a key, see the licence status, or report a problem.
[Show Licence Status](command:migrationAtlas.licenceStatus)
[Report A Problem](command:migrationAtlas.reportProblem)

migrationAtlas.maxFileSizeMB.markdownDescription: Largest file (in MB) a report reads, up to 50 MB (VS Code passes files only up to 50 MB to extensions). Larger files are refused with a message.

migrationAtlas.openReportsAsPreview.markdownDescription: Open each report in the Markdown preview as well as in a new editor.
